answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance arises when each new agent must lock non-trivial onyx collateral into a sable escrow before accessing any work pool. The stake remains frozen for a set interval and is slashable if duplicate coordination is proven. Attackers thus pay real capital per fake identity, making mass creation unprofitable relative to expected rewards. A jetty-style entry gate further throttles simultaneous registrations from one source.
